summary: NumberFormatter is a static utility class in the HSPnet.UI namespace that provides methods for safely parsing strings into numeric values (Decimal and Integer). It returns a specified null value if parsing fails.
purpose: To convert string representations of numeric values into Decimal or Integer types in a way that gracefully handles invalid input, avoiding exceptions by providing a caller-specified fallback value.

fields.name: NumberString
fields.description: The string value to attempt to parse into a numeric type.

fields.name: nullValue
fields.description: The value to return if parsing fails.

workflows.name: Parse Decimal
steps: Accept NumberString and nullValue as input.
Attempt to parse NumberString into a Decimal.
If parsing succeeds, return parsed Decimal.

workflows.name: Parse Integer
steps: Accept NumberString and nullValue as input.
Attempt to parse NumberString into an Integer.
If parsing succeeds, return parsed Integer.

business_rules: If the input string cannot be parsed to the target numeric type, the nullValue is returned instead of throwing an exception.
validations: String input is validated using Decimal.TryParse for decimals and Int32.TryParse for integers.
conditions: Parsing only succeeds if the NumberString is a valid numeric representation for the target type.
system_behavior: Prevents exceptions from invalid parsing by returning a safe fallback value.
Provides static methods for parse operations, meaning no instance of NumberFormatter is required.
exceptions: No exception is thrown for parsing failures; a specified null value is returned.
